Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoList
Description: AutoList turns retainer Market Board chores into supervised AutoList, AutoRefresh, and AutoTidy workflows with a small in-game tray that lights up when your character is ready to start.
Punchline: Turn retainer listing from market-board chore into one-click momentum.
Changelog:
Fixed HQ market comparison detection so HQ rows drawn with the Search Results HQ icon are recognised as HQ competitors.
Kept Let HQ undercut NQ behaviour unchanged: when off, HQ listings only price against HQ competitors.
Improved AutoList and AutoRefresh messages when visible listings are rejected because they are not the matching quality.
